story.zh: 黄巾大部队溃散后，赵弘、韩忠等黄巾余部盘踞宛城。朝廷急令朱儁率大军围剿，务求一举荡平黄巾残部，终结这场席卷天下的动荡...
story.en: Following the rout of the main Yellow Turban forces, remnants under Zhao Hong, Han Zhong, and others occupied Wancheng. The imperial court urgently ordered Zhu Jun to lead a massive army to suppress them, seeking to wipe out the Yellow Turban remnants in one stroke and end this turmoil that engulfed the realm...

trigger.zh: 宛城属张角，洛阳属何进，下邳属孙坚，蓟城属刘焉；刘备、关羽、张飞存活且属于正确势力。
trigger.en: Wancheng belongs to Zhang Jiao, Luoyang belongs to He Jin, Xiapi belongs to Sun Jian, and Jicheng belongs to Liu Yan, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei are alive and belong to the correct Factions.

forbidden.zh: 主角为孙仲、赵弘、张角、张宝、张梁、邓茂、程远志、张曼成时无法触发
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Sun Zhong, Zhao Hong, Zhang Jiao, Zhang Bao, Zhang Liang, Deng Mao, Cheng Yuanzhi, or Zhang Mancheng

participate.zh: 【身属黄巾势力】，或【身属何进势力且不为朱儁、何进、王允、卢植、张让、马日磾、皇甫嵩】，或【身属刘焉势力】，或【身属孙坚势力】
participate.en: 【Belong to the Yellow Turban Faction】, or 【Belong to He Jin's Faction and not be Zhu Jun, He Jin, Wang Yun, Lu Zhi, Zhang Rang, Ma Midi, or Huangfu Song】, or 【Belong to Liu Yan's Faction】, or 【Belong to Sun Jian's Faction】

defy.zh: 【<非黄巾势力>救下孙仲并收为家将】，【<黄巾势力>成为黄巾势力君主并救下邓茂、程远志】
defy.en: 【<Non-Yellow Turban Faction> Save Sun Zhong and recruit him as a Retainer】, 【<Yellow Turban Faction> Become the Ruler of the Yellow Turban Faction and save Deng Mao and Cheng Yuanzhi】
